notes.title: Kingdom Loop | Demo Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]We’re thrilled to announce that in the upcoming weeks, [b]a free demo version of Kingdom Loop will be released!

[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3972050/Kingdom_Loop_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
The demo will feature [b]support for 12 languages[/b] and more improvements that we can’t wait for you to experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank You for Playtest #3![/b][/h3][p]
We also want to give a huge thanks to everyone who participated in [b]Playtest #3[/b]. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us shape the game. With your support, we’ve taken another big step forward. [b]Playtest #3 is now officially over, but this is just the beginning.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned - there’s much more to come![/p]

notes.title: Playtest #3!
notes.notes:
[h1]🎮 [b]Welcome to Playtest #3![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We've been working hard to improve [i]Kingdom Loop[/i], and we can’t wait to hear what you think![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524139/0ab563088c44586fd427e97349d37e6256a42b7f.png"][/img][/p][p]This update brings a ton of new features:[/p][p]🃏 [b]Cards are now even more valuable[/b] —
Winning battles grants you random cards — the stronger the enemy, the better the reward.[/p][p]⚔️ [b]New Units[/b] —
A variety of new combat units have been added to the Human faction.[/p][p]🏡 [b]Tile Upgrades Through Combos![/b] —
Upgraded tiles can now evolve for free when placed in the right combinations![/p][p]🕹 [b]Turn-Based Combat System[/b] —
Battles are now fully turn-based, with deeper tactical mechanics.[/p][p]📖 [b]Story and Dialogue Updates[/b][/p][p]🏆 [b]Special Grail Tile[/b] —
Can be found at the center of the map.[/p][p]💬 [b]Share your feedback![/b]
Your impressions help us make the game even better. And remember — this is just the beginning. There’s much more to come![/p]

notes.title: Open Playtest Results!
notes.notes:
We're planning to finish our first open playtest on April 17th.
A plenty of your useful feedback came up to us, extremely appreciated! We have already started working on making the game even more enjoyable for you.

What's next then?
Upcoming update information is going to be revealed on April 18th. See you soon at the tiles of the Kingdom!

notes.title: [OPEN PLAYTEST]
notes.notes:
In a week, we will launch the first open playtest for everyone! 
You will be able to evaluate the faction, the location, fight the Boss and different types of enemies! 

Help us make the game better :)
